❯ /exit

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Background work is running
  The following will stop when you exit:

  shell · sleep 600
  monitor · Output of sleep 600 then done marker

  ❯ 1. Exit and stop tasks
    2. Move to background and exit
    3. Stay

  Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
